sources.publication: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Production: Cotton Weed Management
sources.citation: TNAU Crop Guide: Cotton Agronomy Section 4.3
sources.key_takeaway: Conduct shallow inter-cultivation (not exceeding 4–5 cm depth) between crop rows at 20–25 DAS and 40–45 DAS. Maintain adequate clearance from the crop row to avoid severing shallow lateral cotton roots.

sources.title: Intra-Row Hand Weeding and Hoeing
sources.publication: Weed Management in Commercial Crops: Cotton Guidelines
sources.citation: ICAR-DWR Extension Folder No. 18
sources.key_takeaway: Perform manual hand weeding or small hand-hoeing (khurpi) within the crop rows at 20–25 DAS and repeat at 40–45 DAS if weed flushes re-emerge.

sources.key_takeaway: Any post-emergence herbicide spray must be applied as a STRICTLY DIRECTED SPRAY between rows using a protective spray hood or shield. Herbicide droplets must NEVER come into direct or drift contact with green cotton foliage or stems.
